summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, furnishing its Notice of Meeting, Proxy Statement and Proxy Card for an Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 15, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: re-election of auditors and directors, approval of director and CEO compensation, and discussion of annual financial statements. This is a routine proxy solicitation for an ordinary shareholder meeting with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms or strategic changes are involved. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements.
